description: Na₂PtS₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.23 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to five S²⁻ atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaS₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.82-2.96 Å. Pt²⁺ is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four S²⁻ atoms. All Pt-S bond lengths are 2.36 Å. There are two inequivalent S²⁻ sites. In the first S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Pt²⁺ atoms. In the second S²⁻ site, S²⁻ is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Pt²⁺ atoms.
